afterImage.description: DartPoints Holding Company, LLC is a regional digital-infrastructure platform providing colocation, interconnection, cloud, disaster recovery, managed IT and cybersecurity services from edge and regional data centers across the central and southeastern United States. NOVA Infrastructure Fund II acquired control on April 24, 2025. Astra Capital Management retained a meaningful minority interest after selling control, and Orion Infrastructure Capital invested minority equity alongside senior secured debt. Exact economic percentages and acquisition vehicles are not publicly disclosed. Acquired brands, individual sites, real estate and financing SPVs remain beneath the single platform record.
